channel.title: Holistic Life | Home Workouts & Healthy Meals
channel.description: Simple home workouts, small-space gym ideas, and easy high-protein meals for busy people. Run by a registered nurse who believes healthy habits should fit real life.

item.title: Gym Gift Basket for Him or Her: 10 Home Gym Gifts for Small Spaces
item.description: A gym gift basket for him or her starts with gear that fits the space. Ten home gym gifts for small spaces, from adjustable dumbbells to a thick mat and a foldable bench, with what to look for before you buy. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Walking in Winter: Gear and Gift Ideas for Dark Evenings
item.description: Walking in winter is easier with the right gear, and it makes a thoughtful gift for anyone who walks on dark evenings. These ideas help them stay visible, warm and dry, from reflective vests to gloves and a packable jacket. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Nurse Gifts for a New Grad: What a First-Year Nurse Will Use
item.description: Nurse gifts for a new grad's first year on the floor. A short checklist of gear that gets used every shift, plus what to ask first before buying a stethoscope. See what to look for in each. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Full Body Dumbbell Workout for Beginners: 2 Days a Week to Start
item.description: A full body dumbbell workout for beginners can start with two days a week. This guide shows a simple routine, how to pick your weight and when to add more. Calm, clear steps for first-timers. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Dumbbell Set for a Small Space: What to Look For in Adjustable Dumbbells
item.description: Looking for adjustable dumbbells for a small space? Check the weight range, the size of each jump, the locking system, the footprint and the return policy before you buy. A simple checklist to save you hassle. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Lunch Ideas for Work: Easy Meal Prep for Nurses on 12-Hour Shifts
item.description: Lunch ideas for work do not need to be fancy, even on a 12 hour shift. Use the protein, grain and vegetable formula, batch cook once and pack for the week. Easy meal prep for nurses, with ideas that need no microwave. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Gift Basket Ideas for Meal Preppers: Build a Packed Lunch Basket
item.description: Gift basket ideas for someone who packs lunch every day. Start with an insulated lunch bag, then add two locking containers, an ice pack and reusable cutlery. The guide has two more baskets to build and what to look for in each piece. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Easy High Protein Meals for Busy Weeknights: A 5-Night Dinner Plan
item.description: Easy high protein meals for busy weeknights, planned as five dinners. Chicken, turkey, salmon, eggs and beans are the stars, with swaps for what is in your kitchen. Short ingredient lists and quick steps. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Walking for Beginners: How Fast to Walk Using the Talk Test
item.description: Walking for beginners is easier when you know your pace. Use the talk test: you can talk but not sing. This guide explains it, then gives a 4 week walking workout plan with rest days and what to do when you miss one. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Beginner Workout at Home: 15 Minutes, Five Easy Moves, No Gym Needed
item.description: A beginner workout at home for anyone who wants a simple place to start. Warm up, do five gentle moves, then cool down. Includes a weekly schedule and a four week way to build up slowly. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Gifts for Mom She Will Actually Use: Wellness and Comfort Ideas
item.description: Gifts for mom that are not clutter: cozy layers, a yoga mat, a plush robe and more. Wellness, comfort and movement ideas, with what to look for in each one, from a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Sleep Tips for Night Shift Workers: Make Your Room Truly Dark by Day
item.description: Sleep tips for night shift workers start with a dark room. Hang blackout curtains, cover the gaps at the edges, block light under the door and add a sleep mask. A short guide for nurses and shift workers, with gear picks. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Labor and Delivery Nurse Gifts: 10 Small Things Nurses Actually Use
item.description: Labor and delivery nurse gifts work best when they are small, useful and easy to share with the whole unit. Ten ideas from a nurse-run site: sealed snacks, good pens, unscented hand cream and more, plus what many hospitals do not let staff accept. See what to look for in each one. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Treadmill or Walking Pad: Which One Fits Your Home?
item.description: Treadmill or walking pad, compared fairly. See how they differ on space, speed, incline, noise and storage, then decide which suits your home and your routine. Plain advice from a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Small Home Gym Gifts: Gear That Folds, Stacks or Hangs
item.description: Small home gym gifts should fold, stack or hang on a wall. This guide covers how to check floors, noise and weight limits, and what to skip, so the gift gets used instead of stored. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Christmas Gifts for Women and Men Who Love to Walk: A Simple Checklist
item.description: Christmas gifts for women and men who love to walk, made simple: cushioned socks, clip-on lights, an insulated bottle, warm layers and more. A nurse-run checklist with what to look for in each one, so you buy something that gets used. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Gifts for Nurses That Actually Get Used: 12 Practical Ideas
item.description: Gifts for nurses that get used every shift: compression socks, a leakproof bottle, a fob watch, sleep helpers for night shift and more. Twelve practical ideas from a nurse-run site, with what to look for in each one. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Dumbbell Workout for Beginners at Home: 6 Moves With One Pair of Weights
item.description: A dumbbell workout for beginners at home using just one pair of weights. Six full-body moves, sets and reps, how to choose a starting weight and what to avoid. Plan two or three short sessions a week. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Walking Pad Buying Checklist: 9 Things to Check Before You Buy
item.description: A walking pad buying checklist with nine things to check before you order: weight limit, belt size, noise, speed, safety features and the return policy. Plain steps from a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Small Home Gym Ideas: What to Buy First, in the Right Order
item.description: Building a small home gym? Start with a mat, then bands, then adjustable dumbbells, and add a kettlebell or bench only when you are ready. A simple buying order for apartments, with what to look for. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Meal Prep Ideas for Night Shift: What to Pack for a 12-Hour Shift
item.description: Meal prep ideas for night shift, made simple. Pack one main meal, two snacks and water, and use a cold bag and ice pack to keep food safe. A short guide for nurses and shift workers, with three sample packs. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Meal Prep Gift Basket Ideas: Kitchen Gifts for Someone Who Cooks Ahead
item.description: Meal prep gift basket ideas for people who batch cook on Sundays. These kitchen gifts make cooking ahead faster, tidier and safer, from locking containers to freezer trays. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: High Protein Dinner Ideas: 5 Easy Recipes Ready in 30 Minutes
item.description: High protein dinner ideas you can make in about 30 minutes. Five simple recipes: sheet pan chicken, a turkey taco skillet, salmon rice bowls, egg fried rice and a white bean soup. Each comes with an easy swap. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Nursing Graduation Gift Ideas: 10 Gifts for New Nurse Graduates
item.description: Nursing graduation gift ideas that get used from the first shift: compression socks, a badge reel, a work bag and more. Ten gifts for new nurse graduates, for pinning ceremonies and graduation, from a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Stocking Stuffer Ideas for Fitness Lovers: 12 Small Gifts That Get Used
item.description: Stocking stuffer ideas for fitness lovers that are small enough for a stocking and useful enough to use. Twelve ideas from a nurse-run site, from loop bands and a jump rope to a cooling towel, with notes on what to look for. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Walking Workout Plan for Beginners: 4 Weeks From 10 Minutes to 30
item.description: A walking workout plan for beginners that builds from 10 minute walks to about 30 minutes in four weeks. Includes a simple weekly table, a talk test for pace and tips for days you miss. Easy to follow and kind to beginners. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: At Home Workouts for Beginners: A Gentle 15-Minute Plan With No Equipment
item.description: At home workouts for beginners can start with 15 minutes and no equipment. Five low-impact moves, easier and harder options for each, and a simple weekly plan. Made for people who have never followed a routine before. Guide contains affiliate links.

item.title: Adjustable Dumbbells Buying Checklist: 8 Things to Check First
item.description: An adjustable dumbbells buying checklist with eight things to check before you order: weight range, small jumps, how fast the weight changes, grip, storage, noise and the return policy. Plain advice from a nurse-run site. Guide contains affiliate links.
